suggested_languages_raw: Other languages (Python, JavaScript with React Native, etc.) are not recommended for core native banking application development.
JavaScript/TypeScript (React Native or Progressive Web App with PouchDB)
Elixir (Phoenix Framework) + JavaScript (React/Vue.js) + Native Mobile (or React Native)
Go (Golang) + JavaScript (React/Vue.js) + Native Mobile (or Flutter/React Native)
Python (Django with Channels/Flask) + JavaScript/TypeScript (React) + Native Mobile
JavaScript (Node.js backend + React/Vue.js frontend + React Native mobile)
Python (with Dash by Plotly or Streamlit)
Java (with Spring Boot for backend, frontend with JavaScript)
C# (with ASP.NET Core for backend, frontend with JavaScript)
Python (via Pyodide or similar WASM compilation)
Java (with real-time GC tuning, e.g., Azul Zing)
Java (with frameworks like Netty or Vert.x)
Python (with async frameworks like asyncio, FastAPI, or Tornado)
